snippet.title: Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Lead a German Panzer platoon through the chaos of World War II in this definitive version of the intense, anime-inspired tank simulation. Assemble an elite crew, deploy legendary tanks, and survive fierce engagements where cunning and skill will decide victory or defeat. 

Includes three additional bonus tank packs! Take command of the US army’s ‘M4-748 Sherman’ and ‘M26 Pershing’, field the British ‘Churchill VII’, and ‘Valentine XI’, and deploy the Axis’s long-range tank destroyer ‘Elefant’ and super-heavy ‘Panzer VIII Maus’.

Coming 2026 to PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series X|S. 💿 PS5 physical edition also available! 

Wishlist and pre-order now: https://pqube.co.uk/games/panzer-knights/
